headline.en: Adeyemi started at Elche. Gordon started against Athletic
headline.es: Adeyemi fue titular en Elche. Gordon lo fue ante el Athletic

summary.en: Karim Adeyemi started the Liga opener at Elche. Anthony Gordon started the next match against Athletic and stayed on for 80 minutes. Gordon did not leave Newcastle to be a rotation option. Both players can play on the left. Only one will start against Rayo on Monday.
summary.es: Adeyemi fue titular en Elche. Gordon lo fue ante el Athletic y jugo 80 minutos. El lunes ante el Rayo solo habra un puesto.

body.en: The hierarchy is weekly, not seasonal. Adeyemi's first week convinced Flick on depth and sprint. Gordon's Athletic night convinced him on press and duels. El Nacional framed Gordon as a signing who will not accept a long spell on the bench. That is a dressing-room problem only if Flick leaves the conversation unspoken. The honest version is that both were bought to cover Raphinha's absences and to give the first line a different runner. Rayo, sitting deep, may suit Adeyemi's run behind the full-back. A midweek against a side that plays may suit Gordon. Keeping both useful means using both before Feyenoord. Leaving one unused until October turns a depth signing into an argument. Flick does not owe either man a starting place. He does owe the squad a readable rotation so the press does not collapse when Raphinha needs a rest. Monday is the first vote, not the last.

headline.en: Yamal played 90 minutes against Athletic and took seven shots
headline.es: Yamal jugo 90 minutos ante el Athletic y remato siete veces

summary.en: Lamine Yamal played the full 90 minutes against Athletic Club. MARCA counted seven shots, three on target, five chances created, 45 completed passes and three dribbles. Unai Simon and the woodwork stopped the goal. After Elche, Flick said Yamal was coming back from three weeks of holiday and had still taken part in both goals there.
summary.es: Yamal jugo los 90 ante el Athletic. MARCA le conto siete tiros, tres a puerta, cinco ocasiones, 45 pases y tres regates. Simon y la madera evitaron el gol.

body.en: Yamal's week is a minutes story that keeps being written as a scoring drought. Flick used about an hour at Elche, then the full match against Athletic. Luis de la Fuente has already spoken about calling him back to Spain. That combination, plus an 18:45 European kickoff on 9 September, is how a 19-year-old gets overplayed in August. The Athletic film shows the usual actions: receive, beat the first man, shoot. Simon was excellent. The finish will come if the minutes stay stepped rather than leaping from 60 to 90 to a midweek without a plan. The club is not writing a crisis and the numbers do not require one. Seven shots is volume. Zero Liga goals is a waiting room. The danger is the next jump, not the post. If Rayo, Spain and Feyenoord all want him in the same ten days, the three-week holiday stops being context and starts being a warning. Barcelona can live without a Liga goal from him in August. They cannot live with him unavailable in the first European fortnight because August was greedy.

headline.en: Barcelona beat Athletic Club 2-0 with goals from Raphinha and Fermin
headline.es: El Barca gano 2-0 al Athletic con goles de Raphinha y Fermin

summary.en: Barcelona beat Athletic Club 2-0 at Camp Nou. Mundo Deportivo wrote that Unai Simon and two shots against the post prevented a larger score. Raphinha and Fermin Lopez scored. Pau Cubarsi and Pedri started. Gavi did not. Barcelona have seven Liga goals and none conceded after two matches.
summary.es: El Barca gano 2-0. Simon y dos palos evitaron un marcador mas ancho. Raphinha y Fermin marcaron. Siete goles a favor y cero en contra.

body.en: The match confirmed two early trends. One is the attack without a classic nine. Raphinha and Fermin both arrived in the space a centre-forward would occupy. The other is selection. Cubarsi came in for Christensen. Pedri started ahead of Gavi. Gordon started ahead of Adeyemi. Espart stayed in the side. Athletic were not Elche, and Simon was the reason the night did not become a rout. Seven scored and none conceded is the table. The film is a team that creates enough to win if the first wave fails. Rayo will try to make that first wave fail for longer. That is why this result should not be copied forward as proof that the false nine always works. It worked against a side that left space. The next opponent will not. Flick can still change the reference. He has not done it yet. Monday tells us whether 2-0 against Athletic was a platform or a ceiling for this version of the press.
